name: TransCentury Plc
source: TransCentury Plc audited summary consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2024, published on the NSE filing library (summary consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income). Figures are as printed in KShs thousands and stored as absolute KES. Includes the FY2023 and FY2022 operating profit/(loss) lines as filed.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored with a negative sign, which broke the printed identity Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT); the magnitude is unchanged and the column now carries the positive cost sign the identity requires

rows.label: Profit/(Loss) before Depreciation, Impairment and Finance Costs
Net Finance Costs
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored with a negative sign, which broke the printed identity Operating Profit (EBIT) - Net Finance Costs = Profit Before Tax; the magnitude is unchanged and the column now carries the positive cost sign the identity requires

rows.label: Income Tax Expense
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Basic and Diluted Earnings Per Share (KShs)
ROA (%)
rows.derivedFrom: ROA (%) = Net Profit / Total Assets x 100

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Profit (EBIT) = Gross Profit - Operating Expenses
rows.note: Filed operating profit/(loss) line from the audited statement. Replaces an earlier derived value that omitted Net Other Income, Impairment Losses and Depreciation and Amortisation.

derivation.ratiosNote: ratio cells tagged derived are arithmetic on the filed figures of this security, not printed in the source

reconciliation_note: Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit and Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit, to the unit, for every stored period. Gross Profit minus Operating Expenses does NOT equal Operating Profit (EBIT) in this statement: the issuer strikes operating profit after Net Other Income, Impairment Losses and Depreciation and Amortisation. The Operating Profit (EBIT) row now carries the issuer printed operating profit/(loss) line (FY2024 714,538; FY2023 (371,400); FY2022 (883,835), KShs thousands).
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
